text:
Your best ideas never come. Not because you lack talent.

You're in the wrong mental state.

You built a mind that waits.
A mind that consumes.
A mind that scrolls.

Not one that creates.

That requires eight deliberate switches.

Music elevates you.
Friendship focuses you.
Mastermind partnerships multiply you.
Love clarifies you.
Desire burns you.
Auto suggestion rewires you.
Shared suffering bonds you.
Fear sharpens you.

Not luck. Not inspiration.
Your deliberate mental fuel.

Best ideas always exist. Activated minds rarely do.
caption:
Your best ideas need an activated mind. The eight discipline and mindset shifts successful men use to receive them daily. Send this to a man who needs it today.
